sources.title: Microsoft Building Footprints — Features, hosted by Esri
sources.processing: All 1310 footprint features returned by bbox intersection query retained. Geometry coordinates unchanged. Renamed properties and added source attribution. No building heights, floor counts, occupancy, or flood depths inferred.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.processing: Roads and named waterways converted to GeoJSON and clipped to bbox; waterway names inherited from relations. OSM building polygons were not used because the extract lacks buildings around Cruso. No geometry generated or inferred.

sources.title: USGS NWIS Site Service
sources.processing: Gauge metadata transcribed from downloaded RDB record.

sources.title: USGS annual peak-flow record
sources.processing: Fred and Helene annual peak flow and stage verified. Helene peak discharge qualifier 9 means discharge due to snowmelt, hurricane, ice-jam or debris-dam breakup; the source does not distinguish which within the code.

sources.title: USGS instantaneous values
sources.processing: Stage (00065) and discharge (00060) joined by original timestamp. All non-missing source samples and per-variable qualifiers preserved. A means approved.

NOAA OWP inundation-mapping
sources.processing: Method reference only; no NOAA inundation product is included.

sources.title: U.S. Census Bureau 2019–2023 ACS 5-year median household income and 2023 TIGERweb block groups
sources.processing: Three whole block groups intersecting the study rectangle; exact GEOID join to B19013 income estimates and 90% margins of error. 2023 inflation-adjusted USD. All geometry and raw summary-table cells retained. See the separate Census provenance for download URLs and SHA-256 checksums.

limitations: No DEM, HAND raster, calibrated rating curve, hydraulic simulation, bundled predicted flow, observed building depths, Census population allocation, or validated exposure statistics are included. Documented ACS block-group income context is bundled separately in census-block-groups.geojson; see census-provenance.json.
Observed events are USGS gauge measurements only. An animated spatial water overlay based on these data is schematic and cannot be labeled measured inundation or depth.
USGS gage height is relative to a local gage datum; it is not water depth and cannot be subtracted directly from HAND without calibrating reference elevations and local reach stage.

Microsoft footprints are machine-extracted from imagery of mixed vintage. The service does not provide event-date capture metadata here; structures may have changed or been removed. OSM river and road geometry is a current map snapshot. Neither is a verified complete event-date inventory.
Microsoft footprints lack verified heights here. Any default building extrusion must be disclosed as illustrative.
The display extent is a rectangular study area, not a hydrologically delineated basin boundary. Its features cannot support whole-basin exposure counts.
USGS site decimal coordinates were reported in NAD83. For this illustrative visualization they are used as WGS84 without a coordinate transformation; source accuracy is one arc second.

Census income estimates pool 2019–2023 responses and describe full block groups, including parts outside the display rectangle. They are not event-specific or individual-household incomes. Margins of error use 90% confidence; point estimates alone do not establish significant differences or income-specific flood exposure.
